code_changes: Bounded first-person crude-oil/natural-gas operational outputs require exact SEC accession; prospective/negated/other-entity language is excluded.

Input-cost/company relation must be within180 characters of the resource; macro-only and distant risk/list context cannot create company exposure. Resource terms after an output verb are not input terms.
CommodityEnergyAgent validates unchanged SEC issuer path, ticker context, matching captured content/filing metadata, and locally rejects conflicts without losing other completed observations.
Matching exact primary SEC acceptance clock can refine date-only filingDate; precise clock conflicts, naive/future acceptance and wrong CIK/accession/report period/reference are rejected.
Filing/statement/source-observation/exposure-knowledge clocks and historical CIK/accession propagate through exposures/reference documents; current legal/instrument attribution remains unset.
Legacy generic SEC Archives scout questions preserve unverified candidate semantics and cannot create a new precise-accession output or acceptance proof.

primary_filing.clock_crosscheck: Independent raw filing-index HTML and old-CIK submissions JSON agree.
primary_filing.known_in_application_from: Actual2026-10-13 capture/replay only; not backdated to SEC filing date.

validation.environment: Local Linux; offline captured/synthetic checks. No Windows end-user acceptance.

integration_points: CommodityEnergyAgent indexes exact prefetched filing DocumentRecords from context.state.agent_results when present. Existing SEC producer wiring supplies those documents without app/pipeline changes.
Exact acceptance metadata is optional on matched SEC DocumentRecord (acceptanceDateTime/accepted_at plus exact primary source URL); absence remains explicitly unverified, never fabricated.
ResourceMarginScenarioService already refuses its cost formula for COMMODITY_OUTPUT; no scoring/scenario formula changed.
limits: Only historical issuer CIK34088; current XOM successor/Q3 instrument resolution remains separate and unresolved here.
Two quoted operating disclosures are not issuer-wide legal asset ownership, quantity or revenue-share verification.
Macro series prices are not company-exposure evidence and are not joined.
Today's observation does not create earlier point-in-time source history; source availability at earlier cutoffs remains false.
No relevant full coverage denominator, historical OOS proof, Windows end-user run or DONE promotion.
Existing manual what-if input scenarios remain observational; no forecast/scoring/trading changes.
